# Orbit

> An open-source, self-hosted CLI and Gateway for running applications on infrastructure you own. Build an always-on development network that your agent can operate.

## Get started

- [Get started with Orbit](/get-started.md): Start here when a user shares this site. It tells you what to settle with the user, then sends you to the Quickstart.
- [Quickstart](https://orbit.nckrtl.com/docs/quickstart.md): Install a Gateway, add a development Node, and open a first App. Written for an agent and its user together.

The homepage also returns the guide when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`.
The direct Markdown URL works regardless of the client's user-agent identifier.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://orbit.nckrtl.com/docs/llms.txt): Every page with a one-line description. Append `.md` to any page URL for Markdown.
- [Concepts](https://orbit.nckrtl.com/docs/concepts.md): Gateway, Node, Cluster, App, App instance, Route, and the other terms Orbit uses.
- [Architecture](https://orbit.nckrtl.com/docs/architecture.md): CLI, Gateway, Nodes, and application traffic.
- [CLI reference](https://orbit.nckrtl.com/docs/cli/overview.md): Every command family.
- [Orbit repository](https://github.com/nckrtl/orbit): Source.
